subtitle: "Baseline vs revised cross-frame comparison after the Livability AQI swap"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

baseline_output_dir <- here(
  "exploration",
  "intelligence_framework",
  "phase_5_cross_frame_integration",
  "outputs"
)

revised_output_dir <- here(
  "exploration",
  "intelligence_framework",
  "phase_5_cross_frame_integration",
  "outputs_aqi_median_review"
)

read_phase5_bundle <- function(output_dir, scenario_label) {
  list(
    scenario_label = scenario_label,
    pca_variance = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_pca_variance.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    kpi_decisions = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_kpi_decisions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    candidate_metric_sets = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_candidate_metric_sets.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    calibration = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_cluster_count_calibration_comparison.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    cluster_centroids = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_cluster_centroids.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    cluster_representatives = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_cluster_representatives.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    candidate_list = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_candidate_list.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    overlap_summary = readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_phase5_overlap_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
    scores = arrow::read_parquet(file.path(output_dir, "cross_frame_scores.parquet"))
  )
}

baseline <- read_phase5_bundle(baseline_output_dir, "baseline_aqi_unhealthy_days")
revised <- read_phase5_bundle(revised_output_dir, "review_aqi_median")

metric_presence <- bind_rows(
  baseline$kpi_decisions |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$kpi_decisions |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  filter(metric_id %in% c("aqi_unhealthy_days", "aqi_median")) |>
  select(
    scenario,
    frame_id,
    feature_id,
    metric_id,
    communality_retained_pcs,
    max_abs_loading_retained_pcs,
    recommendation_stage,
    recommended_for_clustering
  )

selected_metric_summary <- bind_rows(
  baseline$candidate_metric_sets |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$candidate_metric_sets |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  group_by(scenario, metric_set) |>
  summarise(
    selected_metrics = sum(keep_for_candidate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

selected_metric_membership <- bind_rows(
  baseline$candidate_metric_sets |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$candidate_metric_sets |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set", keep_for_candidate) |>
  select(scenario, feature_id, metric_id, frame_id)

selected_metric_compare <- full_join(
  selected_metric_membership |> filter(scenario == "Baseline") |> rename(baseline_metric_id = metric_id, baseline_frame_id = frame_id),
  selected_metric_membership |> filter(scenario == "Revised") |> rename(revised_metric_id = metric_id, revised_frame_id = frame_id),
  by = "feature_id"
) |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      !is.na(baseline_metric_id) & !is.na(revised_metric_id) ~ "kept_in_both",
      !is.na(baseline_metric_id) & is.na(revised_metric_id) ~ "baseline_only",
      is.na(baseline_metric_id) & !is.na(revised_metric_id) ~ "revised_only"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(status, feature_id)

calibration_compare <- bind_rows(
  baseline$calibration |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$calibration |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set")

summary_compare <- tibble::tribble(
  ~scenario, ~selected_metric_count, ~best_k, ~best_kmeans_silhouette, ~k6_kmeans_silhouette,
  "Baseline",
  baseline$candidate_metric_sets |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set", keep_for_candidate) |> nrow(),
  baseline$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set") |> slice_max(order_by = kmeans_avg_silhouette, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(k),
  baseline$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set") |> summarise(best = max(kmeans_avg_silhouette)) |> pull(best),
  baseline$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set", k == 6) |> pull(kmeans_avg_silhouette),
  "Revised",
  revised$candidate_metric_sets |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set", keep_for_candidate) |> nrow(),
  revised$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set") |> slice_max(order_by = kmeans_avg_silhouette, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(k),
  revised$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set") |> summarise(best = max(kmeans_avg_silhouette)) |> pull(best),
  revised$calibration |> filter(metric_set == "moderate_35_kpi_set", k == 6) |> pull(kmeans_avg_silhouette)
)

cluster_shift_compare <- baseline$scores |>
  select(
    cbsa_code,
    cbsa_name,
    baseline_cluster_name = cross_frame_cluster_name,
    baseline_percentile = cross_frame_percentile
  ) |>
  left_join(
    revised$scores |>
      select(
        cbsa_code,
        revised_cluster_name = cross_frame_cluster_name,
        revised_percentile = cross_frame_percentile
      ),
    by = "cbsa_code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percentile_shift = revised_percentile - baseline_percentile,
    cluster_name_changed = baseline_cluster_name != revised_cluster_name
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(percentile_shift)))
```

## Snapshot

```{r}
summary_compare |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  kable()
```

## AQI Metric In The Reduced Model

```{r}
metric_presence |>
  mutate(
    communality_retained_pcs = round(communality_retained_pcs, 3),
    max_abs_loading_retained_pcs = round(max_abs_loading_retained_pcs, 3)
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## Selected KPI Count

```{r}
selected_metric_summary |>
  kable()
```

## Moderate 35-KPI Membership Changes

```{r}
selected_metric_compare |>
  count(status) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
selected_metric_compare |>
  filter(status != "kept_in_both") |>
  select(feature_id, baseline_metric_id, revised_metric_id, status) |>
  kable()
```

## PCA Comparison

```{r}
bind_rows(
  baseline$pca_variance |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$pca_variance |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  slice_head(n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = principal_component, y = cumulative_variance, color = scenario, group = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative PCA variance",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative variance",
    color = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Moderate 35-KPI Cluster Calibration

```{r}
calibration_compare |>
  ggplot(aes(x = k, y = kmeans_avg_silhouette, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(calibration_compare$k))) +
  labs(
    title = "K-means silhouette for the selected 35-KPI set",
    x = "Cluster count (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette",
    color = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
calibration_compare |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  kable()
```

## Cross-Frame Cluster Centroids

```{r}
bind_rows(
  baseline$cluster_centroids |> mutate(scenario = "Baseline"),
  revised$cluster_centroids |> mutate(scenario = "Revised")
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
  kable()
```

## Biggest Cross-Frame Percentile Shifts

```{r}
cluster_shift_compare |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  mutate(
    baseline_percentile = round(baseline_percentile, 1),
    revised_percentile = round(revised_percentile, 1),
    percentile_shift = round(percentile_shift, 1)
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## Representative Metros In Revised Run

```{r}
revised$cluster_representatives |>
  group_by(cross_frame_cluster_name) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(cross_frame_cluster_name, cbsa_name, cross_frame_percentile, distance_to_center) |>
  mutate(
    cross_frame_percentile = round(cross_frame_percentile, 1),
    distance_to_center = round(distance_to_center, 2)
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## Candidate Markets

```{r}
revised$candidate_list |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  select(divergence_candidate_rank, cbsa_name, cross_frame_cluster_name, cross_frame_percentile, character_percentile, livability_percentile, opportunity_percentile, divergence_candidate_score) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
  kable()
```
